items.title: I have $125,000 in credit-card debt. Will $17,000 a month in income, including disability, affect my bankruptcy?
items.description: “I racked up this debt to cover my living expenses for two years without an income stream.”

items.title: ‘My main goal is to help people’: I’m single, 74, with $10 million burning a hole in my pocket. What should I do?
items.description: “I also own my home and an SUV outright, with no outstanding debt.”

items.title: My rental property is paid off, but I need cash. Is this a bad time to take out a $50,000 HELOC?
items.description: The Federal Reserve announced a quarter-percentage-point interest-rate hike Wednesday, to a range of 3.75%-4.0%.

items.title: Snoopy cups at Starbucks and McDonald’s SpongeBob toys are commanding huge markups on eBay
items.description: Adults are scooping up promotional items out of nostalgia — and playing into a frenzy around collectibles .

items.title: ‘My total balance should be $20 million’: I invested $1.1 million in a crypto platform. Have I lost it all?
items.description: “I invested on the recommendation of an executive vice president of a major New York investment bank.”

items.title: China is chasing SpaceX and setting its sights on the global space economy
items.description: Chinese space-technology players are looking to grow their reach, experts say. They’re closing in on Elon Musk and company.

items.title: ‘There might be a silver lining’: My friend’s wife died at 60 after a high-earning career. Can he claim her Social Security?
items.description: “They had been married for over 30 years when she passed.”

items.title: Record diesel prices are exposing pain points in the stock market and economy
items.description: A major risks now is that diesel prices stay high — and continue to put upward pressure on inflation.

items.title: ‘I’m burned out’: I’m constantly helping my cousin who is running out of money. Is it too much to expect his sister to help?
items.description: “I spend a lot of time away from my family and spend money on gas, taking him out to eat.”

items.title: Midterm voters are overwhelmingly worried about the national debt. But only small fixes are expected this year.
items.description: Watchdog groups say midterm voters feel that “something’s wrong.”
